generation.text:
I remember the day vividly, a chilly autumn morning as I was preparing for my first day at a new job. I was eager, nervous, and a bit over-prepared. In my excitement, I had double-checked everything - my resume, my outfit, my schedule. Yet, in my haste, I overlooked one tiny detail.

When I arrived at the office, I eagerly presented my neatly folded resume to the receptionist. She smiled and said it was very well done
